text:
Lina M.: quick sync - staging showed warmup tokens not applied when prewarm nodes landed in sibling shard, want a concrete decision
Victor H.: saw ~20 prewarms over last week with token-mismatch; tenant saw delayed bursts, small but noticeable
June T.: options: 1) pool-level tokens, 2) atomic transfer on finalize, 3) sibling-lease lookup during admission
Omar R.: pool-level easiest but loses per-shard isolation. enterprise won't like cross-shard spending
Victor H.: transfer is safest but requires reliable commit. two-phase commit seems heavy for our scale
June T.: sibling-lease seems promising: admission tries local token, then asks siblings with a short lease TTL to avoid races
Lina M.: main concerns: double-spend and latency. we target admission add <20ms
Omar R.: implementation: local in-memory lease cache + remote CAS-backed lease store. common case hits cache, fall back to remote CAS on miss
Victor H.: need refunds if host dies with held leases. propose short TTL + periodic reconciler that refunds stale leases and reports drift metrics
June T.: rollout plan: behind feature flag, unit race tests, staging soak 48h, 5% canary, monitor `double_spend` and p99 admission latency
autoscaler-bot: [scale-event] prewarm tenant=neo-labs gpus=6 job=prewarm-1734999999 status=created
Lina M.: assign owners: Omar=proto, Victor=metrics/alerts, June=reconciler. sync next Tue with perf numbers
